verdict.rationale: gstack is itself a shareable skill set. Its docs describe a vendored (project-local) install alongside the global one, which implies it can be committed to a project repo so the whole team gets the same skills. However, no doc describes a team-distribution workflow, and a community commenter notes the git-clone-and-copy model may buckle across repos that need divergent review or QA flows. Missing for 10: documented team-wide distribution workflow, a marketplace or registry channel, explicit guidance on committing a vendored install to a shared repo, and independent hands-on corroboration of team rollout.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project
